title: A scalar auxiliary variable-based semi-implicit scheme for stochastic Cahn--Hilliard equation
summary: In this paper, we present a novel semi-implicit numerical scheme for the stochastic Cahn--Hilliard equation driven by multiplicative noise. By reformulating the original equation into an equivalent stochastic scalar auxiliary variable (SSAV) system, our method enables an efficient and stable treatment of polynomial nonlinearities in a semi-implicit fashion. In order to accurately capture the impact of stochastic perturbations, we carefully incorporate Itô correction terms into the SSAV approximation.
